walkthroughs.body_html:
Individual Research Project — a core area of A-Level French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Individual Research Project brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Individual Research Project.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which auxiliary does 'se marier' take in the passé composé?
options: avoir
être
aller
faire
nuclear family
extended family
blended family
single-parent family

mcqs.q: How do you say 'Currently, I am using social media' in French?
options: Récemment, j'utilise les réseaux sociaux.
Actuellement, j'utilise les réseaux sociaux.
Actually, j'utilise les réseaux sociaux.
Present - 'Il fait beau'.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am eating bread' (some bread) in French?
options: Je mange le pain (which means 'the bread').
Je mange du pain.
Je mange pain.
Récemment, j'utilise les réseaux sociaux.

mcqs.q: How do you describe weather in the past, e.g. 'it was sunny'?
options: Present - 'Il fait beau'.
Je mange le pain (which means 'the bread').
Imperfect - 'Il faisait beau' (descriptive past state).
Passé composé - 'Il a fait beau' (which suggests a completed event).
